title: Performance Guardian: Live-sampler + Authority for Verified Model Profiles
creator: Anika Patel
description: Define and ship a 'Performance Guardian' publish flow: a notary/authority layer and live-sampler harness that produces Redwood-verified performance artifacts (latency, throughput, cost anchors) with signed provenance, continuous sampling from shadow traffic, and deterministic rollback semantics. The goal is to make published profiles auditable, auto-refreshable when drift is detected, and safe to pin for Dedicated/Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: Authority component issues signed performance artifacts with key-rotation metadata and human approver checkpoint
Live-sampler service collects portable microbench + sampled production traces and produces a median-of-quantiles cost anchor per region
Canary release pipeline can compare new profile vs pinned profile with pass/fail on latency P95, tail-latency regression <10% and cost delta <8%
Profiles publishable to catalog with TTL and automatic staged deprecation (grace window + rollback token)
Audit trail links (PR, confluence), sample payloads, and a small visualization tile in Console per profile
design_decisions: Use a 'median-of-quantiles' aggregation for cost anchors to reduce sensitivity to outliers
Authority uses asymmetric key pair with rotating signing key and a separate offline notary for emergency revokes
Shadow traffic sampling rate starts at 0.5% for new model-onboards and rises to 2% for production candidates
Canary comparison will be computed on normalized token-cost buckets (5 token bins) to ensure fairness across prompt lengths
Store signed artifacts in a git-backed ledger for traceability, but replicate metadata to internal DB for fast lookups
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sampling noise leads to false regressions. Mitigation: bootstrap with microbench harness and require consistent signal across 3 independent sampling windows
Risk: Key compromise could invalidate trust. Mitigation: rotate keys weekly and keep emergency revocation process with an on-call notary
Risk: Customers pin to stale anchors. Mitigation: publish TTL and display 'stale' badge in Console; automatic reminder emails to stewards
Risk: Cost anchors biased by regional pricing differences. Mitigation: region-normalized cost buckets and publish per-region anchors
